description: Add real tests that GENUINELY EXECUTE the fused decision/threshold/cap/best-so-far/failure-report machinery (worked-example fixes stand in for the LIVE per-iteration Copilot fix, exactly as prior phases did). Prove: green+gate-pass => converged; green+gate-fail => needs_fix with the exact scanner findings in the structured failure report; best-so-far selection across iterations; cap => stop-and-ask with best-so-far + residual summary; the three callers all use the SAME decision (assert verdict PARITY); config threshold tuning changes the outcome. Keep the no-LLM/no-model guard tests green and all 275 existing tests unchanged and green.
steps: test_evalloop.py: add tests for evaluate_quality_gated using scan.make_finding to construct scanner findings. (1) green verify summary + findings below threshold => status green/converged, no failure report. (2) green verify summary + a finding at/above fail_on_severity (or a security finding over the max_findings cap) => needs_fix; assert the EXACT findings and the gate block are present in the structured failure report and that build_failure_report's existing keys are still present.

test_evalloop.py: best-so-far test. Drive evaluate_quality_gated across multiple iterations with scripted worked-example findings that improve then worsen (e.g. iteration 1 has a high finding, iteration 2 clears it to a low finding = better, iteration 3 regresses to a high finding again). Assert the tracked best-so-far is iteration 2 (the lowest-residual-severity attempt), not the last.

test_evalloop.py: cap/stop-and-ask test. With --max-iterations driven low and findings that never clear the gate, assert the final decision status is stop/max_iterations_reached, the ask text is specific, and it carries the BEST iteration reached plus a residual-findings summary (not merely the last attempt when an earlier one was better).

test_evalloop.py: config-tuning test. With the same findings, assert that a stricter review.thresholds (e.g. fail_on_severity: medium) FAILS the gate while a looser one (fail_on_severity: critical) PASSES it - proving the quality bar is tunable and changes the converged/needs_fix outcome.

test_orchestrate.py / test_scaffold.py: PARITY test. Construct one code/test case and route it through (a) verify.py --iterate / evalloop.evaluate_quality_gated directly, (b) scaffold.decide_generation, (c) orchestrate.decide_task - with identical inputs (same findings, same verify result, same thresholds, same cap) - and assert the gate block + converged/needs_fix/stop verdict agree across all three (verdict parity), proving a single shared decision.

test_e2e_loop.py (and test_cpp_e2e.py if the C++ scanners/toolchain allow): EXECUTED fused-loop proof for Python at minimum. Build a case where tests are green but the reviewer gate FAILS on a real/worked-example finding, run the fused decision, assert needs_fix with the scanner findings in the report; then a scripted 'fix' that clears the findings so the next iteration CONVERGES (green + gate passes); then a never-converging case that hits the cap and STOPS with best-so-far + residual summary. Clearly mark executed-vs-worked-example.
Keep/extend the no-LLM/no-network tripwire tests so they still assert the fused path imports nothing network/LLM and spawns no model.
Run the full suite with timeout >= 600000 ms and confirm the previous 275 tests plus the new tests all pass.
acceptance_criteria: New tests cover: converged (green+gate pass), needs_fix (green+gate fail) with findings folded into the structured failure report, best-so-far selection, cap => stop-and-ask with best-so-far + residual summary, verdict parity across the three callers, and config threshold tuning changing the outcome.
The fused decision/cap/best-so-far/failure-report machinery is GENUINELY executed in the tests (not mocked away); worked-example fixes stand in for the live Copilot fix.
All previously-passing tests still pass; the no-LLM/no-network guard tests stay green.
Each new test would FAIL if the corresponding production code path were reverted (meaningful coverage).
verification: .venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q (timeout >= 600000 ms) passes the full suite including the new tests
findings: Added 18 new tests (all genuinely execute the FEAT-002 fused machinery; tests-only, NO production changes needed -- no real bug surfaced). Full suite now 293 passed (275 pre-existing + 18 new) in ~244s. Breakdown: test_evalloop.py +14 (reqs 1-4, 6-Python, 7); test_scaffold.py +2 and test_orchestrate.py +2 (req 5 parity triple); test_e2e_loop.py +2 and test_cpp_e2e.py +2 (req 6 executed proof). Key facts asserted against FEAT-002: (1) evaluate_quality_gated(repo_path, adapter, options, state) with options['cycle'] (precomputed), options['findings'] (presence turns reviewer gate on; absence => tests-green backward-compat), options['thresholds'] (override), options['max_iterations']. green verify + findings below bar => status 'green' with reviewer_gate riding along and NO failure_report; green verify + a finding at/above fail_on_severity OR a security finding over max_findings cap => 'needs_fix' with report['reviewer_gate'] (exact scan.apply_thresholds block) + report['scanner_findings'] (exact make_finding list) folded onto the SAME report, all pre-existing keys (repo/adapter/ok/failing_phases/counts/regression_delta/golden_failures/invariant_violations/differential_regressions) preserved; JSON-serializable. (2) best-so-far: driving one LoopState across 3 scripted iterations (2 high / 1 medium / 2 high) under a 'medium' bar tracks state.best_so_far.iteration==2 (lowest residual severity), stable at 2 after iter3 regresses (not the last). (3) cap: max_iterations=3 with never-clearing findings => status 'stop', reason 'max_iterations_reached', iteration never exceeds cap, ask names the cap AND 'best attempt was iteration 2', best_so_far carries iteration 2, _residual_summary renders 'medium=1'. (4) config tuning: same single medium finding FAILS fail_on_severity:medium (needs_fix) and PASSES fail_on_severity:critical (green). (5) parity: identical inputs (same findings/verify_result/resolved review.thresholds via scan.resolve_thresholds+load_review_config) through evalloop.evaluate_quality_gated, scaffold.decide_generation, orchestrate.decide_task agree on the gate block (scaffold.gate == evalloop reviewer_gate == task_dec.verdict.gate) and the verdict (evalloop 'needs_fix' == scaffold/task 'iterate'; all 'green' on a passing gate). To feed evalloop the SAME inputs scaffold builds internally, the parity tests reconstruct scaffold's precomputed cycle (_parity_cycle/_gen_cycle). (6) executed proof: samples/pyapp's real pytest and samples/cppapp's real CMake+GoogleTest+CTest run for real (layer1 disabled, no precomputed cycle) => green verify; a worked-example HIGH finding fails the reviewer gate (needs_fix, finding in report); a scripted empty-findings 'fix' converges (green); a never-clearing variant hits the cap and stops with best_so_far + residual summary. C++ tests guarded by shutil.which(cmake/ctest). GOTCHA for future features: _residual_summary groups residual findings by SEVERITY (e.g. 'high=1'), NOT by category -- a security-category high finding renders as 'high=1'. No-LLM/no-network tripwire extended to assert evaluate_quality_gated/score_iteration/resolve_review_thresholds exist and the source carries no forbidden network/LLM token.
